integrity.proof_basis: Exact integral identities, strict log-convexity and boundary asymptotics, with finite checker as cross-check
integrity.source_premise: Single OU-K stationary symmetric beta law in arXiv:2611.17625v1 Theorem 3.2, credited to Ratanov

scientific_limitations: Equal independent symmetric telegraph filters; no unequal-rate or shared-noise result
Boundary peaks are density divergences and carry no atoms
No claim to exhaustive historical priority; a 2022 related publisher paper remained inaccessible
Analytic argument is not externally assessed
title: Sharp three-peak to single-peak threshold for independent telegraph-driven harmonic filters
